_about: Data re-use edges stated in a paper, added by hand (2026-09-25). from_pmid / to_pmid are corpus PMIDs; from_id may name a consortium node (coll:...) or, since 2026-09-29, a drawn source node (ext:<pmid> for a GEO series' paper, smri:...). kind uses the tracker Vocabulary (subjects, samples, regions). A curated edge replaces any other link between the same two nodes in the same direction. 'other_data' (2026-09-29): per study (PMID or node id), data it re-used that no drawn node holds, listed under the study's 'Other data used' (label, why, optional pmid / gse). 'flagged_for_review': studies whose lineage group the paper contradicts, left for Paul (tests/corpus/test_lineage_reuse_shown.py skips them). Entries dated 2026-09-29 come from a check of every study flagged also_reuses or in group 3 that showed no re-used data on the page. Read by build_lineage.py.
